paseo.commit_message:
Start the daemon when an empty paseo.pid was left behind (#5306)

A supervisor killed between creating paseo.pid and writing its contents
leaves an empty file. Every later start, status, and stop then failed
with "Cannot read daemon state", so the daemon stayed down until someone
deleted the file by hand.

An empty lock names no owner, so after the existing read retries it now
reads as no lock, and acquiring the lock removes it before creating a new
one. A lock with unparseable contents still refuses, since it may belong
to a supervisor this version cannot read.

Co-authored-by: paseo-bot[bot] <266920839+paseo-bot[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>

ruflo.release_body:
# RuFlo 3.44.0: the agent picker gets fixed on your machine, and gets measured

**Released 23 September 2026.** Upgrade:

```sh
npx ruflo@latest --version    # should print: ruflo v3.44.0
```

---

## The short version

- **The word-matching fix from 3.43.0 now reaches your computer.** The file that picks agents for your prompts was never updated after it was first installed. It now updates itself.
- **A new, optional, smarter agent picker** uses a real language model instead of comparing spelling. It's off by default. Turn it on with one setting.
- **We built a test to decide which picker should be the default**, and ran it. The honest result: none of the new options met the bar yet, so the default stays as it is. The numbers are below.

---

## 1. Your installed agent picker now updates itself

Every time you type a prompt in Claude Code, RuFlo's hook suggests which kind of agent should handle it. It does this with a small file, `router.js`, in `~/.claude/helpers/`.

3.43.0 fixed a bug where it matched parts of words: "review the la**test** issues" went to the *tester* because "latest" contains "test". **But the fix never reached anyone.** `router.js` was written once, when RuFlo was first set up, and upgrades never replaced it. On the maintainer's own machine, it was from April.

**Now `router.js` is one of the signed files RuFlo keeps up to date.** The next time you run any `ruflo` command, it checks the file against a cryptographically signed list and replaces it if it's out of date:

| Prompt | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| "sync and review latest issues" | tester | reviewer |
| "are we uing typesafe" (typo) | frontend-dev (because of "ui") | coder |
| "write unit tests for the auth module" | tester | tester |

*(ADR-389)*

## 2. Optional: a picker that understands meaning

RuFlo also has a second, "semantic" picker (`hooks route`). Until now it compared **spelling patterns**, not meaning. That's why it still thought "latest" looked like "test".

RuFlo already ships a real language model (MiniLM) for its memory search. 3.44.0 lets the picker use it too:

```sh
export CLAUDE_FLOW_ROUTER_EMBEDDER=minilm
npx ruflo hooks route --task "fix the login crash"
#  default picker: tester  ✗
#  with minilm:    coder   ✓
```

It costs about 5 extra milliseconds per prompt, plus a one-time model load of about 0.3 seconds. If the model isn't available, it quietly uses the old method and tells you so in its output (`embedder=hash`). *(ADR-390)*

## 3. How we decided what the default should be

Instead of guessing, we built a test (ADR-391):

- **197 realistic requests**, the kind people really type, each labelled with the right agent. A third are deliberately tricky ("the author field is missing in the prefix list" is a coding job, not an auth one).
- **Labelled blind.** The person doing the labelling never saw what any picker chose.
- **Frozen.** The list is locked with a checksum, so it can't be quietly adjusted later.

Then we ran four pickers on the same held-out 113 requests:

| Picker | Got it right | Time per prompt (95th percentile) |
|---|---|---|
| Current default | **26%** | 1.1 ms |
| With the language model (new option above) | **36%** | 6.2 ms |
| typesafe, basic | 27% | 1.2 ms |
| typesafe, with a model | 29% (44% before its safety gate) | 8.3 ms |

**The rule for changing the default** was set *before* running the test: more than 2 points more accurate, no new required download, and no more than 5% slower. The language-model option is clearly more accurate (+10 points) but is 5 ms slower, which breaks the "5% slower" rule because the current picker only takes 1 ms. So **the default did not change**, and the rule was not bent to make it pass.

**What the test taught us** (these are the next steps):

1. **The picker can't give the right answer for about 30% of requests.** It has no category for "researcher", "reviewer" or "not an engineering task at all". Adding those will probably help more than any model change.
2. **The speed rule should probably be an absolute limit** (say, under 10 ms), not "5% slower than 1 ms". That's a decision for the maintainers, recorded in the ADR, and not changed quietly here.
3. **The typesafe picker is the most accurate when it answers (44%)**, but its "am I sure?" check is too strict and lets it answer only 6% of the time. That needs tuning.

## Also fixed

- A test for the optional typesafe picker had been failing on the main branch since 3.43.0. It expected the old "latest → tester" mistake. It now checks the right thing.

## How this release was checked

- Every required release test passed:
  - codex 241
  - security 583
  - federation 640
  - 121 CLI tests, including all new router tests
- The five signed helper files were verified against the signed list.
- The packed release was installed into an empty folder and tested:
  - A deliberately out-of-date `router.js` was replaced after one `ruflo` command, and it stopped sending "latest" to the tester.
  - The language-model option picked "coder" for "fix the login crash", where the default picks "tester".

## Full details

- ADRs: 389 (keep the picker updated), 390 (language-model option), 391 (the test and its results): `v3/docs/adr/`
- The test set and the script to re-run it: `v3/@claude-flow/cli/benchmarks/router/`
- Pull request: #3410


Also published as a gist: https://gist.github.com/ruvnet/6ad4931d63360b0945ab148ad609e5d5

🤖 Generated with [RuFlo](https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo)

multica.commit_message: MUL-7642: full-window attachment viewer that pages through every file (#8763) * feat(attachments): full-window viewer that pages through every file (MUL-7642) The preview was a centered card capped at max-w-6xl, so a screenshot never showed larger than 1152px wide whatever the screen, and prev / next only walked images. - The viewer takes the whole window: no card, a near-black stage, a top bar in the dark token set, prev / next in 64px side gutters, type / pixel size / file size instead of the MIME type. Markdown and text read on a centered sheet in the app theme; PDF and HTML fill the stage. - The surface sequence now covers every previewable kind, so an issue pages through its screenshots, PDFs, reports and HTML in render order. `collectAttachmentSequence` takes the inclusion rule; mobile keeps the images-only `collectImageSequence`. - The issue description block no longer lists every issue attachment as its own: comment uploads keep issue_id, so they were counted at the description's position. - A focused video / field keeps its arrow keys. Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 Co-authored-by: multica-agent * fix(attachments): viewer image swap and desktop window chrome (MUL-7642) Review of #8763: - Paging from a PDF (or any non-image) onto an image that had not decoded yet handed the PDF's URL to ; its load error was blamed on the image being opened, which got marked broken and skipped. The settled-URL hook now only ever holds a URL that decoded as an image, and the reports errors only when it shows the current file. - On desktop the full-window top bar sat under the macOS traffic lights and over the app's top-bar drag region. The viewer now enters immersive mode while open, marks itself no-drag, lets its top bar drag the window, and opts the bar's controls back out. Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 Co-authored-by: multica-agent * fix(attachments): viewer waits for the media re-sign before loading (MUL-7642) On clients that cannot load `/api/attachments/{id}/download` natively (desktop, split-origin web, self-host proxy mode) the viewer handed that endpoint to while the re-sign / authenticated byte fetch was still in flight. The native load failed, and in a sequence the failure read as a broken image: it was marked unavailable and skipped before the loadable URL arrived. `useResignedInlineMedia` now also reports whether the upgrade is pending. The viewer holds the previous frame (or shows loading) until it settles, and the neighbour prefetch waits too. The inline figure keeps its behaviour. Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 Co-authored-by: multica-agent * fix(attachments): no focus ring around the viewer stage on open (MUL-7642) The viewer focuses its zoom canvas on open so +/-/0 and the arrows work without a click. That programmatic focus can match :focus-visi

orca.release_body:
Thank you so much for using Orca and for your continued support! ❤️

## The short version

**Agents & chat:** Session search now shows the newest activity first, and launch prompts go straight to terminal agents. OpenCode, Claude, Pi, Antigravity and Devin launches are more reliable. Usage totals now price GPT-6, Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1, and Codex usage no longer goes stale after a reset.

**Terminal, editor & workspaces:** Drag selection holds steady during redraws, middle-click paste works in mouse-tracking TUIs, and remote panes keep their scrollback across restarts. PDF zoom sticks across tabs and restarts, the new-worktree dialog keeps its buttons in view while you scroll, and large artifact and conflict lists stay fast.

**Remote & reliability:** WSL, SSH and Windows setups recover more cleanly, and relay rehomes and cell rollouts handle failures without taking a cell down.

---

## Product experience

### Agents, chat & search

*Search is easier to trust, agent launches are more direct, and large workspace lists stay responsive.*

* feat(agent-launch): deliver a launch prompt to a terminal agent by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21891
* feat(session-search): sort search results by newest, and break relevance ties by recency by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21863
* Virtualize artifacts list with reusable component by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22061
* Virtualize large conflict file trees by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21920
* refactor: use generic VirtualizedList in conflict review by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22092
* Fix stale listings when search query changes by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22173
* refactor(agent-status): drop two superseded Codex attention workarounds by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21844
* fix(native-chat): scope a tool row's hover reveal to that row by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21918
* Clear website annotations after successful delivery by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22060

### Usage reporting

*Codex, OpenCode, and Claude cost totals are more complete and stay fresh.*

* Fix stale Codex usage after reset by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21748
* fix: read OpenCode Go usage from the console API by @innocarpe in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21462
* fix(opencode): include cache read and write usage totals by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21886
* fix(usage): price GPT-6 Astra, and declare when the Codex cost total omits a model by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22073
* fix(usage): price GPT-6 Sol/Luna, Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1, and correct GPT-5.6 rates by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22350

### Terminal

*Input, selection, paste, composed text, and remote scrollback are more consistent.*

* fix(terminal): keep Pi input visible in open synchronized frames by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21708
* fix(terminal): preserve Polish and Option-composed text in kitty panes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21082
* fix(terminal): keep drag selection stable during redraws by @nwparker (release-branch fix, see https://github.com/stablyai/orca/compare/v1.4.207...v1.4.209)
* fix(terminal): arm native-paste suppression on middle-click in mouse-tracking TUIs by @buf0-bot in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21834
* fix(terminal): let Shift+middle-click paste in mouse-tracking panes by @buf0-bot in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21858
* feat(terminal): configure interactive Unix shell arguments by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21904
* fix(terminal): persist a parked remote pane's scrollback across a hard restart (#21295) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21367
* fix(mobile): make OMP terminal momentum refresh-rate independent by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21687

### Editor, workspaces & source control

*PDF work, Markdown navigation, worktree dialogs, and source-control hover states are more consistent.*

* fix(editor): persist PDF zoom across tabs and restarts by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21879
* fix(editor): open plain details blocks in rich markdown mode by @SahilZ0810 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19784
* fix(editor): preserve Markdown preview when following wiki links by @SahilZ0810 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19790
* Keep new worktree dialog actions visible while scrolling by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21915
* Consolidate source control tooltips to eliminate redundant hover text by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21733
* Fix Antigravity source-control model discovery and retired defaults by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21606

### Providers & assistants

*OpenCode, Claude, Pi, Antigravity, and Devin launches behave better.*

* fix(opencode): preserve global config discovery by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21854
* fix(opencode): attribute shared-server sessions to their panes by @werlang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21577
* fix(opencode): isolate v1/v2 plugins and preserve WSL config by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21900
* fix(opencode): support v2 plugins under plain executable name by @nwparker (release-branch fix, see https://github.com/stablyai/orca/compare/v1.4.207...v1.4.209)
* fix(opencode2): auto-submit quick command prompts by @nwparker (release-branch fix, see https://github.com/stablyai/orca/compare/v1.4.207...v1.4.209)
* fix(claude): stream the provider history window by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21742
* fix(claude): prefill continuation context for manual submission by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21912
* fix(pi): keep panes working while async subagents run by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21882
* fix(orchestration): line-settle delay for antigravity multiline paste by @seonghobae in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21665
* fix(antigravity): recognize non-Gemini tui-idle prompts by @innocarpe in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21231
* fix(devin): skip workspace trust for Orca launches by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21925

### Remote, SSH, WSL & Windows

*Guest materialization, profiles, rebuilds, and connection floors are more resilient.*

* fix(wsl): await Pi and OMP guest relay materialization by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21721
* fix(wsl): preserve OpenCode agent variant in guest by @nwparker (release-branch fix, see https://github.com/stablyai/orca/compare/v1.4.207...v1.4.209)
* fix(worktree): recognise the Windows profile through WSL's drvfs view by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20051
* fix(windows): prune the unpatched conpty prebuild by header, not host arch by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20048
* fix(ssh): keep the generation floor when a target is removed and recreated by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22146
* fix(remote-runtime): stop an unhydrated host graph from reading as a closed terminal by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21967
* fix(rebuild): refuse to compile node-pty source that lacks the MSYS breakaway denial by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21968

### Relay & reliability

*Rehomes, cells, and same-cap rollouts recover more cleanly.*

* fix(relay): abort rehomes whose host never arrived, without disabling the switch by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21813
* fix(relay): let the rehome evidence parser read a line the director grew by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21823
* fix(relay): stop a terminated checked-out PostgreSQL client from killing the cell by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21840

orca.commit_message:
feat: name runtime machines (#22094)

* feat: name runtime machines

* fix: preserve pairing address optionality

* fix(cli): keep host and environment listings local

Listing paired servers read each one's machine name by dialing it, so both listings made a network
round trip per server and waited out a timeout on any that were offline. They answer from this
machine's own pairing store; `orca host name --environment <name>` reads one server's name.

* fix(settings): caption the machine name paired devices actually receive

The caption read the runtime's published name once, when the pane opened, so saving an override
left it naming the old computer while phones already showed the new one. It now re-reads whenever
the saved override changes; the settings write lands in the main process before the store publishes
it, so that read already sees the new name. The name is interpolated rather than baked into the
fallback, and the caption, label and placeholder are in the English catalog.

* refactor(settings): normalize the machine name in one place

The trim and length rules for `machineName` were spelled out separately at the
renderer IPC (trim + 255), the settings load path (trim only, no cap), the RPC
schema (zod trim + 255) and the runtime reader (trim). A hand-edited or legacy
profile could therefore load a longer name than any writer accepts.

`src/shared/machine-name.ts` now owns `MACHINE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH` and
`normalizeMachineName`, and every writer and the load path use it. The RPC
schema keeps rejecting over-long names but derives its cap from the constant,
and the runtime settings controller normalizes an RPC write before storing it.

* fix(runtime): detect the machine name once and label handoffs with it

Every runtime constructed in a process (the app, plus each one a test builds)
ran its own `scutil` lookup. The friendly name is a property of the host, so the
lookup is now a single shared promise; construction still never blocks on it,
and a rejected lookup can no longer surface as an unhandled rejection.

The structured-chat handoff banner ("Agent is open in terminal on X") named this
host with the bare `os.hostname()` while paired devices saw the published name.
The transport now reads the same `RuntimeMachineName`, through a getter so a
rename in Settings is reflected without rebuilding the transport.

* fix(cli): print the name the runtime publishes and keep its envelope

`orca host name --name X` printed `undefined`: `settings.update` replies with
`{ settings }`, but the handler read a bare `machineName` off the reply, and the
test fixture mirrored the wrong shape so it passed. After a write the command
now re-reads `status.get` and prints what the runtime publishes, so a blank
`--name` prints the detected name it returned to rather than an empty string.

The read path wrapped a possibly routed answer in a local envelope, stamping
`_meta.runtimeId: "local"` on a reply from another server. It now returns the
`status.get` envelope itse

GenericAgent Desktop 桌面版 / Desktop

三个平台产物来自同一提交，并在公开发布前统一验证。All three platform artifacts come from one commit and are validated before publication.

## 安装方法 / Installation
- Windows x64：下载 `GenericAgent-Desktop-Windows-Portable.zip`，解压后双击 `GenericAgent.exe`。卸载时运行 `uninstall.bat`，再删除解压目录。
  Windows x64: extract `GenericAgent-Desktop-Windows-Portable.zip`, then launch `GenericAgent.exe`. Run `uninstall.bat` before deleting the extracted directory.
- Linux x86_64：下载并解压 `GenericAgent-Desktop-Linux-Portable.tar.gz`，执行 `chmod +x GenericAgent.AppImage` 后运行它。卸载时运行 `uninstall.sh`，再删除解压目录。
  Linux x86_64: extract `GenericAgent-Desktop-Linux-Portable.tar.gz`, run `chmod +x GenericAgent.AppImage`, then launch it. Run `uninstall.sh` before deleting the extracted directory.
- macOS Apple silicon (arm64)：打开 `GenericAgent-Desktop-macOS-aarch64.dmg`，把 `GenericAgent.app` 拖入 Applications。
  macOS Apple silicon (arm64): open `GenericAgent-Desktop-macOS-aarch64.dmg` and drag `GenericAgent.app` to Applications.

## 签名状态 / Signing status
Windows 便携版尚未使用代码签名证书，SmartScreen 可能显示警告；运行前请核对 `SHA256SUMS-windows.txt`。
The Windows portable build is not code-signed, so SmartScreen may warn; verify `SHA256SUMS-windows.txt` before running it.

macOS 应用仅使用 ad-hoc 签名，未使用 Apple Developer ID，也未 notarize。首次打开可能需要右键选择“打开”或在“隐私与安全性”中允许。
The macOS app is ad-hoc signed only. It is neither Developer ID signed nor notarized; first launch may require Open from the context menu or approval in Privacy & Security.

SHA-256 清单与各产物一同发布。SHA-256 manifests are included with the artifacts.

claude_codex_bridge.release_body:
# v8.7.1

Released: 2026-09-21

## English

### Highlights

- This release includes the previously local `v8.7.0` input protection: human
  drafts delay eligible queued messages for up to 180 seconds, then one clear
  and empty-input confirmation precede delivery. Continued typing does not
  reset that timer. Requests and replies retain one chronological queue per
  agent and wait for the preceding processing turn to end. Recommended initial
  testing is with Claude, Codex and OMP; other input guards will follow.
- Click a local file or press Enter in the Rich file browser to open it with
  the system default application. Click or Enter on a directory navigates
  inside Yazi. Safe and rich profiles share the behavior; mouse opening targets
  the clicked file rather than a previous hover or unrelated selection.
- macOS uses `open`. Linux prefers `gio open`, falling back to `xdg-open` only
  when GIO is absent. WSL detects its kernel or session environment and uses
  `wslview` from `wslu` to open files through Windows associations, including
  mounted-drive and distribution paths. Missing `wslview` produces an error;
  it does not silently fall back to a Linux GUI. WSL interop must be enabled.
- Filenames containing spaces, quotes and shell punctuation remain individual
  arguments. Multiple selected files are supported. Opener failures are not
  automatically retried through a different application.

### Upgrade and validation

- After upgrading CCB, run `ccb update rich`, then reopen the file-browser pane.
  No Agent restart is required for this file-browser change. Generation updates
  CCB-owned profiles only, leaving user Yazi settings and system associations intact.
- To load the input guard and new OMP extension, finish active tasks, save
  drafts, then stop the project with `ccb kill` and restart it with `ccb`.
- Linux native Yazi 26.5.6 mouse/Enter and directory navigation tests passed in
  disposable tmux servers with recording desktop openers. macOS and WSL command
  routing, arguments and failure handling were tested with platform stubs; real
  macOS/WSL GUI launches were not tested. An accepted OS launch request alone
  does not prove a desktop window rendered. SSH does not open on the client PC.
- Version checks now require all README badges, newest embedded release entries and current APK download links
  to match `VERSION`, with a bilingual notes file for that version.

### Known limitations

- The input guard is a first version for testing. Codex/Claude use `Ctrl-C`
  for deadline clearing, so concurrent human actions can still be interrupted;
  capture, clear, paste and Enter are not atomic. Drafts are not backed up.
  Unknown/busy/modal input waits without clearing. OMP requires the new
  extension and default Status Band layout; unsupported paths remain unprotected.
- Ambiguous-send terminalization and OMP bridge production review remain open.
  Forced-daemon-stop Codex remote-session recovery remains manual: inspect
  `ccb screen <agent>` and `ccb trace <job_id>` before cancelling a never-sent
  queued task, restarting the agent and resubmitting it. No automatic recovery
  or universally interruption-free input is claimed.

## 中文

### 版本亮点

- 本版包含此前仅本地提交的 `v8.7.0` 输入保护：用户草稿会让已满足投递条件
  的队首消息最多等待 180 秒，到期清空一次并确认输入为空后投递。继续键入
  不重置计时。请求与返回继续共用每个 Agent 的时间顺序队列，等待前一消息
  的处理回合结束。推荐先在 Claude、Codex、OMP 测试，其他输入保护后续适配。
- 在 Rich 文件面板中点击本地文件或按 Enter，使用系统默认应用打开。
  点击目录或在目录上按 Enter，仍在 Yazi 内导航。safe 和 rich 配置行为一致，
  鼠标打开的是点击的文件，不会误用之前悬停或其他选中的文件。
- macOS 使用 `open`；Linux 优先使用 `gio open`，没有 GIO 时才用
  `xdg-open`。WSL 根据内核或会话环境识别，通过 `wslu` 的 `wslview`
  使用 Windows 文件关联打开，路径包括挂载盘和发行版内文件。缺少
  `wslview` 时明确报错，不静默退回 Linux GUI；必须启用 WSL 互操作。
- 文件名中的空格、引号、Shell 特殊字符保持为完整参数，支持多选文件。
  打开失败时不会自动换用另一个应用重试。

### 升级与验证

- 升级 CCB 后运行 `ccb update rich`，再重新打开文件面板。本次文件面板
  修改无需重启 Agent。生成器只更新 CCB 自有配置，不改个人 Yazi 设置或
  系统文件关联。
- 要加载输入保护和新版 OMP 扩展，请先完成当前任务、保存草稿，再用
  `ccb kill` 停止项目，用 `ccb` 重新启动。
- 已在独立 tmux 中用真实 Linux Yazi 26.5.6 验证鼠标、Enter 和目录导航，
  桌面打开工具用记录程序替代。macOS、WSL 的命令选择、参数和失败处理
  已用平台桩验证，未在真实 macOS/WSL 桌面验证。系统接受打开请求不等于
  已确认窗口显示；SSH 不会把文件打开到客户端电脑。
- 新增检查要求各语言 README 徽章、最新内嵌版本记录、当前 APK 下载链接与 `VERSION`
  一致，并存在对应版本的中英文说明。

### 已知限制

- 输入保护是首版测试功能。Codex/Claude 到期使用 `Ctrl-C` 清空，同时发生
  的人工操作仍可能被中断；抓屏、清空、粘贴、Enter 非原子操作，不备份草稿。
  输入未知、忙碌或弹窗状态会等待而不清空。OMP 要求新版扩展和默认 Status
  Band 布局；未支持的路径仍没有输入保护。
- 发送不明终局处理及 OMP 桥接的生产审查仍未关闭。强制停止 daemon 后
  Codex 远程会话仍需人工恢复：先用 `ccb screen <agent>` 和
  `ccb trace <job_id>` 检查，再取消尚未发送的排队任务、重启 Agent 并
  重新提交。不宣称能够自动恢复或在所有情况下都不打断人工输入。

> ## Documentation Index
> Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.trytrellis.app/llms.txt
> Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.

# v0.6.17

> 2026-09-12

Devin CLI 会话记忆、按需读取 SQLite 页，以及任务/会话绑定修复。

## 功能增强

### Devin CLI 会话适配器

`trellis mem` 通过现有的零依赖解析器读取 Cognition Devin CLI 会话，数据在 `~/.local/share/devin/cli/sessions.db`（WAL SQLite）。这不是 `trellis init --devin`（Desktop/Cascade），也不是 Factory Droid。（#614）

* `list` / `search` / `extract` / `context` / `projects` 支持 `--platform devin`
* OpenCode、ZCode 与 Devin 共用 `packages/core/src/mem/internal/sqlite-adapter.ts` 和 `packages/core/src/mem/platforms.ts`
* Devin 会话树要求 `main_chain_id`；缺少 tip 时返回 `devin-main-chain-missing`（不再回退到 `max(node_id)`）
* 解析前去掉 `CREATE TABLE` 的 `--` 行注释，这样 live `sessions.db` 里的 `parent_node_id` 和 `chat_message` 能被识别

## 问题修复

### SQLite 主文件页懒读

`packages/core/src/mem/internal/sqlite-readonly.ts` 里的零依赖 SQLite 读取器按需加载主文件页，不再把整个数据库读进内存。（#596）

### Pi 无头子代理提示

Pi `trellis_subagent` 把 ask-policy 提示转发到父会话。serving heartbeat 设置 `PI_SUBAGENT_PARENT_SESSION`（不用过期的 `PI_SESSION_ID`），设置 `PI_SUBAGENT_CHILD=1`，并丢掉继承来的 `PI_SESSION_ID`，让子进程自己签发会话 id。（#611）

### 活动任务会话回退

当前会话 id 缺失时，不再回退到项目里仅有的那条会话去解析活动任务。该回退改为显式 opt-in，避免一个会话绑到另一个会话的任务。（#608）

### archive 子任务 unlink 回滚

如果 `task.py archive` 在已经 unlink 部分子任务之后失败，会按清除前的快照把每个子任务的 `parent` 写回去。`children` 里的重复条目只快照一次，避免第二次访问把 `parent: null` 写回去。（#613）

## 升级

```bash theme={null}
npm install -g @mindfoldhq/trellis@latest
trellis update
```

无需 `--migrate`。
